subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve pending replies on forced restart

question: Should `openclaw daemon restart --force` become a bounded 5s best-effort drain instead of an immediate/no-active-work-wait escape hatch for this bug fix?
rationale: The code change is a plausible fix, but it changes documented operator behavior and automation cannot decide whether the compatibility tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Accept bounded force drain after proof
options.body: Require live pending-reply restart proof and operator wording alignment, then treat the 5s drain as the new force-restart contract.

options.title: Keep force immediate
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a different pending-reply recovery design that preserves immediate forced restart semantics.

options.title: Accept compatibility risk now
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the behavior change before full proof, but that leaves the live message-delivery path less verified.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded force drain after proof
recommendation.body: Require live pending-reply restart proof and operator wording alignment, then treat the 5s drain as the new force-restart contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre authored the closest merged restart-drain budget work in the same run-loop/test surface.
